svg.title: What the static_ref stage does to a chunk
svg.text: (a) the stage in the chain (encode order; decode runs right to left)
stored chunk: an FCHN envelope (shape (2, 12, 2, 16 361), stack [field_terms, static_ref]) around the LATC container: 1 073 264 bytes
(b) one chunk: 2 dates × 17 fields × 2 members × 16 361 cells (synthetic test data)
the static_ref header: 2 × 5 × 2 = 20 slots, C order of x[:, static_fields, :, :] (5 REFERENCE, 15 REPEAT, 0 INLINE)
date 0: each static on member 0, member 1
date 1: each static on member 0, member 1
the store's sidecar <store>/.codecs/statics/: the 5 arrays, captured on first sight (the store was the capture target)
REF: the sha256 of a sidecar file; REP: the sha256 of an earlier slot of the chunk, whose values it reuses; INL (none here):
the values in the header. Whatever the kinds, the stage emits 17 − 5 = 12 fields.
